Your project's own rules say headings in the docs folder should not end with a period. The rule comes from the `## housekeeping` section of .pi/gauntlet-overrides.md.

The heading becomes `# Widget setup`, with only the final period removed. Nothing else links to this heading, so nothing else changes. You get one pull request containing this change, and your current checkout stays as it is.

Pick one:
1. [ ] Fix - Build this class in its own worktree and open its own pushed PR against the default branch; leave the primary's tracked files unchanged. [recommended]
2. [ ] Ticket - file one ticket listing them and change nothing now
3. [ ] Ignore - leave them as they are
